# vergeio_permission (Resource)

Grants a user or a group rights on a VergeOS table, or on one object in that table. Set `user_id` or `group_id`, not both. Omit `object_id` to grant the rights on every row of `table`. VergeOS stores that grant with row 0.

Rights are the booleans `list`, `read`, `create`, `modify`, and `delete`. They are not a bit mask. VergeOS turns `list` on when `read` is on, so `list` must be true or omitted when `read` is true.

Changing the grantee, the table, or the object replaces the permission. Changing a right updates it in place.

## Example Usage

Grant a group list and read on every VM.

```terraform
# Grant a group list and read on every VM. Omit object_id for a table grant.
# VergeOS stores that grant with row 0.

resource "vergeio_permission" "all_vms" {
  group_id = vergeio_group.operators.id
  table    = "vms"
  list     = true
  read     = true
  create   = false
  modify   = false
  delete   = false
}

resource "vergeio_group" "operators" {
  name        = "operators"
  description = "Operators"
  enabled     = true
}
```

Grant one user read and modify on a single VM.

```terraform
# Grant one user read and modify on a single VM.
# Rights are separate booleans. They are not a bit mask.

resource "vergeio_permission" "web_vm" {
  user_id   = vergeio_user.operator.id
  table     = "vms"
  object_id = 123
  list      = true
  read      = true
  create    = false
  modify    = true
  delete    = false
}

resource "vergeio_user" "operator" {
  name     = "operator"
  enabled  = true
  password = "change-me"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `table` (String) VergeOS table the grant applies to, such as `vms`, `vnets`, `volumes`, `tenants`, `users`, or `groups`. Changing it replaces the permission.

### Optional

- `create` (Boolean) Create rows in the table, or child objects of this row. Omit to keep the current value.
- `delete` (Boolean) Delete the table rows or the object. Omit to keep the current value.
- `group_id` (String) Key of the vergeio_group that receives the grant. Set `user_id` or `group_id`, not both. Changing it replaces the permission.
- `list` (Boolean) See the table or object in listings. VergeOS turns list on when read is on. Omit to keep the current value.
- `modify` (Boolean) Update the table or object. Omit to keep the current value.
- `object_id` (Number) Row key of one object in `table`. Omit to grant the rights on the whole table. VergeOS stores that grant with row 0. Changing it replaces the permission.
- `read` (Boolean) View the table or object. When read is true, list must be true or omitted.
- `user_id` (String) Key of the vergeio_user that receives the grant. Set `user_id` or `group_id`, not both. Changing it replaces the permission.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Permission key assigned by VergeOS.

## Import

Import is supported using the permission key. The next refresh records `user_id` or `group_id` from the identity on the grant.

```shell
terraform import vergeio_permission.example <id>
```
